summary.text: Charlotte Nutt is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 48, in the November 3, 2026 general election. She won the June 9, 2026, Democratic primary and previously ran for the Maine House in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Charlotte Nutt ran in the 2024 general election for Maine House of Representatives District 79 as an Independent for Maine candidate and received 46.5 percent of the vote, losing to Republican Michael Lance.
In 2026 she advanced unopposed from the Democratic primary for District 48 and faces Republican Erik Hobson in the general election.
